reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE channel = 'store'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY order_month
), compared AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025, with the month before
  SELECT month, revenue_eur, LAG(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue_eur
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, revenue_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (revenue_eur - prev_revenue_eur) / prev_revenue_eur, 1) AS change_pct
FROM compared
